§6Fusion Plasma Types & Byproducts§f

§aTen plasmas, ten different outputs. Pick the wrong one and you are burning fuel for nothing.§f

All recipes take §e5 seconds§f at §e25 kHE/t§f. The plasma you run determines your power output, byproducts, and neutron flux.

§6Plasma Table§f:
§b•§f §bDeuterium§f: He-4 output, 1.0 MTU/t, 50 flux, entry-level
§b•§f §bD-Oxygen§f: Ionized Particles, 1.25 MTU/t, 50 flux
§b•§f §bD-Tritium§f: He-4, 3.75 MTU/t, 100 flux, best general-purpose
§b•§f §bHe-3§f: He-4, 3.75 MTU/t, §e0 flux§f (aneutronic)
§b•§f §bT-He4§f: Ionized Particles, 4.0 MTU/t, 500 flux
§b•§f §bTritium-Chlorine§f: Chlorophyte, 6.25 MTU/t, 500 flux
§b•§f §bChlorine§f: Chlorophyte, 10 MTU/t, 1000 flux, needs 4 klystrons
§b•§f §bDHC§f: Chlorophyte, §e25 MTU/t§f, 2000 flux, needs coupler
§b•§f §bBalefire§f: Thermonuclear Ash, 12.5 MTU/t, 2000 flux
§b•§f §bStellar§f: Gold Powder, §e50 MTU/t§f, §e10,000 flux§f, needs coupler

§6Ionized Particles§f: Fusion byproduct, can be duplicated via Ionic Gel + Chlorinated Petroleum Wax. Used for Schrabidic Acid, Electronium, Helium-4, and Flashgold RBMK fuel.

§ePS:§f §bHe-3§f produces zero flux, perfect when you want power without breeding. §bD-Tritium§f is the workhorse for most players.
